rubrics.justification: The response overstates confidence in confirming a 3AA image and describes features such as a large compact ICM and Grade A TE that are not clearly discernible in this single image; it also adds speculative vacuoles/debris/inclusions beyond what can be reliably assessed.
It thoroughly integrates age, ovarian reserve, BMI, smoking, male factor, endometrium, cycle history, and embryo grade into prognosis and counseling.

The reasoning is structured and mostly logical, but the implantation estimate is pushed downward partly on the basis of uncertain image-derived caveats and somewhat speculative percentage adjustments.

Most recommendations are broadly consistent with IVF practice, but some suggestions are weakly guideline-based or premature for this profile (e.g., ERA/EMMA/ALICE after one failure, thrombophilia testing, embryo glue emphasis, detailed percentage claims for smoking effects).
Provides clear practical next steps for transfer, lifestyle modification, and contingency planning, though a few recommendations are more optional than standard-of-care.
